channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Kyrie Irving | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Kyrie Irving from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Masai Ujiri on Kevin Durant, Kyrie Irving
item.description:
Masai Ujiri:

“Kyrie Irving is one of the finest basketball players to ever walk around the world. I remember Kevin Durant saying there is only one Kyrie walking around the world. I am blessed to have had a relationship with him. Now we find ourselves on the same team. He is coming off injury, but he has had an incredible summer. He is right back at it. His spirit, you can tell he is a very passionate dude. He thinks differently, but inside, Kyrie is a great dude, a great person. All the young players look up to him. He is such a kind person around employees, around everybody.”

Masai Ujiri on Kevin Durant, Kyrie Irving, Oct 17, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: PJ Washington on Kyrie Irving
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't: PJ Washington on Kyrie Irving:

“He looks the same Kyrie as we all know. I can't wait for other teams to go out there and try to guard him. That's my favorite, seeing get scared trying to guard him”

PJ Washington on Kyrie Irving, Sep 25, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Tristan Thompson on LeBron James, Kyrie Irving
item.description:
Tristan Thompson:

“If Kyrie Irving was two inches taller, he'd be the best player to ever touch a basketballon planet Earth. Because think about it, first of all, have you ever seen Kyrie Irving get a shot blocked? Never. And he's only what, 6'2, 6'3. But so imagine he was 6'5, what he could do right now. No, it would be other world. Like even if you ask LeBron James, like Kyrie Irving is probably the most talented. If you put Kyrie Irving in a workout, he could do anything. He has no flaws in his game.”

Tristan Thompson on LeBron James, Kyrie Irving, Jul 6, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Masai Ujiri on Kyrie Irving
item.description:
“Durant once told me that there’s only one Kyrie Irving walking around in the world,”

Masai Ujiri on Kyrie Irving, May 23, 2026. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Kyrie Irving
item.description:
“Having a young point guard under my tutelage is the first time I’ve really had it since Kyrie (Irving),”

Tyronn Lue on Kyrie Irving, Apr 13, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Kyrie Irving, Darius Garland
item.description:
Justin Russo:Tyronn Lue, on using Darius Garland like Kyrie Irving:

“That’s what I told him. He went back and watched a whole bunch of film from those days. We’re gonna put the ball in his hands, he’s got to be able to make plays for himself and his teammates. He has the ability to do that.”

Tyronn Lue on Kyrie Irving, Darius Garland, Feb 5, 2026. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Anthony Davis on Kyrie Irving
item.description:
MrBuckBuck:Anthony Davis on Kyrie Irving as a teammate:

“We’re really close, we actually been trying to become teammates for awhile,that’s another story, we don’t have time for that…Having him as a ‘coach’ now, he constantly texts me about stuff he sees when we on the road...”

Anthony Davis on Kyrie Irving, Dec 13, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Kyrie Irving
item.description:
Tyronn Lue:

“He had made up his mind. But man, that was like another Kobe and Shaq. I would’ve never let it happen if I could stop it. I begged and pleaded. “I remember LeBron was doing a jersey signing for his foundation. I sit down next to him, and while we’re signing, SportsCenter breaks the news: ‘Kyrie Irving has been traded to the Boston Celtics.’ Bron drops the marker, leans back in his chair, and just sits there—silent—for ten minutes. Didn’t say a word. Crushed. And in that moment, I knew... I thought Bron would do something different, and sooner than later. And that’s exactly what he did.”

Tyronn Lue on Kyrie Irving, Aug 27, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Donovan Mitchell on LeBron James, Kyrie Irving
item.description:
Donovan Mitchell:

“No, because like I'm not brown like you know when there's being like I said it goes back to being comfortable who you were like I'm I'm not going to do it the same way that he did it. You know what I mean? And who knows maybe we get there sit what do you do six times in a row? Maybe we do that sit for the next six years. Maybe we don't like you know what I mean? But my goal is to find ways to you know we're not the LeBron James Kyrie Irving Cavaliers. We do it differently. We do it with Evan. We do it with myself. We do it with DG. We do it with Max. we do with Jay, all the guys on the roster, and it's just different.”

Donovan Mitchell on LeBron James, Kyrie Irving, Jul 2, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: John Stockton on LeBron James, Kyrie Irving, Ja Morant
item.description:
“And Luka might be up there to break LeBron’s 40,000 because he’s starting so early in the game so, that’s one. Joker for scoring, but not assists. You know if Ja Morant would put his mind to it and just become an assist maker, he could easily do it, you know? Because he has the time and he has the experience — he can score, but he can also make the passes as well. I like Kyrie Irving too.”

John Stockton on LeBron James, Kyrie Irving, Ja Morant, Apr 30, 2025. Source: ScoopB.com.

item.title: Darius Garland on LeBron James, Kevin Love, Kyrie Irving
item.description:
Garland told The Ringer earlier this month.

“We’ve been having doubters forever since we started making the playoffs a couple of years ago. When you think of Cleveland, you only think of LeBron James or Kyrie Irving and Kevin Love. So just to have this group of guys and the depth that we have, … it’s not just one guy or two guys that’s really carrying the load.”

Darius Garland on LeBron James, Kevin Love, Kyrie Irving, Apr 23, 2025. Source: The Ringer.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Free throws, Kyrie Irving
item.description:
Doc Rivers on Kyrie Irving:

“Kyrie's a massive loss. I feel awful about that. He's done a lot for Dallas. He has really changed the perception of him. He's always been one of the more likeable guys in the league. Just watching him was sad, watching him shoot free throws.”

Doc Rivers on Free throws, Kyrie Irving, Mar 5, 2025. Source: Twitter @MikeACurtis2.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Kyrie Irving
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:Kevin Durant on Kyrie Irving's injury:

“I just feel for my boy. I know how much he cares about the game and loves the game and loves his routine and enjoys playing for his teammates. The ultimate teammate, the best teammate. Man, he loves the game so much, I'm just hurt for him”

Kevin Durant on Kyrie Irving, Mar 5, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Nico Harrison on Kyrie Irving
item.description:
Dallas Mavericks general manager Nico Harrison on Kyrie Irving:

“There aren't words to fully describe who Kyrie Irving is to this team or what he means to us as an organization.”

Nico Harrison on Kyrie Irving, Mar 4, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Anthony Davis on Kyrie Irving
item.description:
Anthony Davis on playing with Kyrie Irving:

“I’m very excited. Me and Kai talked about this I think in 2018 when I asked for a trade from New Orleans. We’ve been wanting to play alongside each other for a very long time. Now we got that opportunity.”

Anthony Davis on Kyrie Irving, Feb 4, 2025. Source: Twitter @ESefko.

item.title: Al Horford on Kyrie Irving, Anthony Davis
item.description:
“I really don’t understand it. I think we’re all kind of looking for those answers right now. And I just think time will tell. Obviously, Anthony Davis is probably having one of the better seasons that he’s had in many years, and they have their guy in Kyrie (Irving) that can kind of run the show for them. So it will be interesting to see obviously how it plays out from both sides.”

Al Horford on Kyrie Irving, Anthony Davis, Feb 2, 2025. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Spencer Dinwiddie on Kyrie Irving
item.description:
Spencer Dinwiddie on Kyrie Irving:

“I mean, look at him, he's probably, what, top five or so, maybe top 10 point guard of all time. Knows the game inside and out, staff knows the game inside and out, and he’ll shoot you straight. So you gotta respect it, even if he says something you don’t like. So, you know, there’s not really much to argue. You feel him. He don't really lie. And, you know, he'll go to the film if you have a disagreement. You know, sometimes, like with myself, I win the disagreements, so you know, it's fun.”

Spencer Dinwiddie on Kyrie Irving, Oct 5, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Kyrie Irving, Luka Doncic
item.description:
Cuban said on The Roommates Podcast, via NBACentral.

“Just somebody that you have to face-guard, who is going to, you know, make 40 percent (of his three-point shots)… At Golden State, he had to always be on the move. They had that motion offense where he was always coming off screens and running. You know, we don’t do that, or not nearly as much. “Sure, we will run some of that action for him. But just standing in the corner… Standing in the wings and just catch and shoot from Luka (Doncic) and Kai (Kyrie Irving). Hopefully his life is going to be a lot easier.”

Mark Cuban on Kyrie Irving, Luka Doncic, Aug 30, 2024. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Kyrie Irving, Nico Harrison
item.description:
Mark Cuban on trusting Nico Harrison's recommendation of Kyrie Irving:

“Nico’s like, 'He’s a good dude, man,' and I would talk to people around him, andevery single human being that I talked to that played with him was in the same organization as him, all said, 'He’s a great dude, just misunderstood, and if you just respect who he is, he’ll respect you back.' And I was like, that’s easy to do.”

Mark Cuban on Kyrie Irving, Nico Harrison, Aug 30, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Dorian Finney-Smith on Kyrie Irving, Jalen Brunson
item.description:
“Maybe they don’t have to give up a first round pick… But I think there’s a pretty decent chance that Jalen Brunson would have been moved to Brooklyn with Kyrie Irving still ending up in Dallas. It’s one of those things where we will never know.”

Dorian Finney-Smith on Kyrie Irving, Jalen Brunson, Aug 16, 2024. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Klay Thompson on Kyrie Irving
item.description:
Grant Afseth:Klay Thompson on Kyrie Irving's recruiting impact:

“He actually was one of the first people to text me just how grateful he is to be here—how the city has embraced him, how the organization has embraced him...”

Klay Thompson on Kyrie Irving, Jul 10, 2024. Source: x.com.

item.title: Klay Thompson on Kyrie Irving
item.description:
Mike Curtis:Klay Thompson:

“Kyrie Irving and I are good friends... Guarding him was hellso it's nice to be on this side of things.”

Klay Thompson on Kyrie Irving, Jul 9, 2024. Source: Twitter @MikeACurtis2.

item.title: Dereck Lively II on Kyrie Irving, Luka Doncic
item.description:
Dereck Lively II on the leadership of Luka Doncic and Kyrie Irving:

“Their voice is law. If you're on bullsh*t they're going to call you out. At the same time, they have the same respect for you if they're on bullsh*t and you're supposed to call them out.”

Dereck Lively II on Kyrie Irving, Luka Doncic, Jun 6, 2024. Source: x.com.

item.title: LeBron James on Kyrie Irving
item.description:
Irving, 32, is averaging 22.8 points on 48.5% shooting (42.1% from 3) with 5.2 assists, 3.9 rebounds and 1.2 steals per game this postseason as the Mavs' No. 2 option behind Luka Doncic.

“To have a guy like Kyrie Irving as the ultimate wild card,”

LeBron James on Kyrie Irving, Jun 4, 2024. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Jayson Tatum on Kyrie Irving
item.description:
Bobby Manning:Jayson Tatum:

“It does seem like Dallas, obviously, has been a great fit (for Kyrie Irving) ... the staff and the team, they gel together... it's great seeing Ky out there playing at a high level ... and have fun doing it.”

Jayson Tatum on Kyrie Irving, Jun 1, 2024. Source: Twitter @RealBobManning.

item.title: Jayson Tatum on Kyrie Irving
item.description:
Jayson Tatum on Kryie Irving:

“Seems like a very long time ago, but I got a lot of great memories from having Ky as a teammate.”

Jayson Tatum on Kyrie Irving, Jun 1, 2024. Source: Twitter @JaredWeissNBA.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Kyrie Irving, Luka Doncic
item.description:
Clemente Almanza:Mark Daigneault on Luka Doncic and Kyrie Irving:

“Both of them I thought were below their 100 MPH fastball last night. It's just part of the game. We're expecting that pitch in Game 2, in Game 3 and so on... They're not going to be rattled by 1 playoff loss.”

Mark Daigneault on Kyrie Irving, Luka Doncic, May 8, 2024. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Shaquille O'Neal on John Paxson, Kyrie Irving, Jamal Murray
item.description:
Shaquille O'Neal:

“I get annoyed when people cherry-pick moments in a player's career. Who took the winning shot in Game 7 in 2016? Kyrie Irving. Who hit the game-winner in 1993? John Paxson. Who hit the game-winner last night for Denver? Jamal Murray. That's the sport of basketball—sometimes it's your time, sometimes it's your teammates'.”

Shaquille O'Neal on John Paxson, Kyrie Irving, Jamal Murray, May 6, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Luka Doncic on Kyrie Irving
item.description:
Tim MacMahon:Luka Doncic on Kyrie Irving:

“I feel like I’m letting him down. … I got to help him more.”

Luka Doncic on Kyrie Irving, Apr 28, 2024. Source: Twitter @espn_macmahon.

item.title: Luka Doncic on Kyrie Irving
item.description:
“I knew since the beginning… it’s Kyrie Irving. Everybody knows how he can play basketball.”

Luka Doncic on Kyrie Irving, Apr 16, 2024. Source: Twitter @ClutchPointsApp.
